entities.summary: Robert Sheridan is an American artist, creative director, stage visual designer, photographer, and comic book author known for his extensive work in the music and entertainment industries and with the bands Nine Inch Nails and Pearl Jam. He is widely known as a designer of stage visuals. He is also an apparel designer, and founder of Glitch Goods.
